sql: select count(*) from approval_queue where block = 'legal_hr' and object_type = 'legal_doc_review' and status = 'pending'

select count(*) from approval_queue q join intel_items i on q.object_id = 'intel:' || i.id::text where q.object_type = 'legal_doc_review' and q.payload like '%Link: ' || i.url || '%' and q.payload like '%sha256 tiêu đề: ' || encode(sha256(convert_to(i.title, 'UTF8')), 'hex') || '%' and q.payload like '%KHÔNG diễn giải%' and q.payload like '%Nguồn: chinhphu-van-ban%'
